review_evidence: README describes formalization of pitches, accidentals, scales, chords, durations, counterpoint, key estimation, and music-theoretic modeling in Lean.

summary: Retain Prismriver source, examples, and tests because the repository is a music-theory formalization/DSL and the non-core files contain concrete formal musical objects and algorithms.

summary: Surveyed all 30 in-scope files: the five pure top-level import umbrellas (Prismriver.lean, Prismriver/Composition.lean, Prismriver/Example.lean, Prismriver/IO.lean, PrismriverTest/IO.lean), lakefile.lean, the smallest substantive file (Prismriver/Repr/Note.lean), the largest file (Prismriver/Repr/Classical.lean head), and at least one representative file from every remaining category: Theory (Dihedral.lean), Syntax.lean (custom Lean parser/macro code), IO/Xml.lean, Composition/Counterpoint.lean and Composition/Random.lean, the examples/ directory (Necrofantasia.lean), the PrismriverTest/ harness (Common.lean, Main.lean), and Example/Touhou.lean. Every file except lakefile.lean holds genuine formal content: real structure/inductive/instance/def/theorem declarations implementing a music-theory DSL and its algorithms (dihedral-group-theoretic triad/chord analysis, contrapuntal-motion predicates, a custom Lean parser/macro syntax for musical notation, MusicXML/Alda/XML serialization, and algebraic proofs on the Accidental type such as add_comm/add_assoc/sub_neg/add_mul), consistent with the prior review's finding that non-core files here (examples, tests) contain concrete formal musical objects rather than data dumps. lakefile.lean, read in full, contains only Lake DSL build/dependency configuration (mathlib and LSpec requires, package/lean_lib/lean_exe declarations) with no formal mathematical declaration -- it is excluded under FILTER-004 condition 1, matching the same lakefile.lean precedent already applied elsewhere in this review batch. The declaration-keyword grep over the exact 30-file scope found exactly the same 6 files (the 5 import umbrellas plus lakefile.lean) without a theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/elab/noncomputable keyword, all read in full above. The junk-signal grep found 0 lorem-ipsum/dummy/XXX matches; the TODO/FIXME grep found 1 match (Prismriver/Composition/Random.lean), an ordinary developer comment on a real declaration.
